The provided text explores the theme of legacy within the context of a sci-fi narrative. The main idea centers on the burden of responsibility carried by the last of humanity as they travel to a new world. The story emphasizes the duality of this journey: it is driven by hope for a fresh start, yet weighed down by the grief of abandoning Earth. Ultimately, the message highlights how individual actions and decisions have profound consequences for the future of the entire species.
